# JobQueue.onPop() method

Registers the handler called for each job popped from this queue.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onPop(handler: JobQueuePopHandler<T>): JobQueue<T>;
```

## Parameters

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

[JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;

this queue, for chaining

## Remarks

Required before [JobQueue.start()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue.start/) or [JobQueue.push()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue.push/)<!-- -->, both of which throw without it. Replaces any handler already registered — the last call wins. See [JobQueuePopHandler](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueuepophandler/) for what its return value does.
